name: Margaret  Matthews
original_name: มากาเร็ท แม็ททิวส์
source: Maggie Matthews is young, dark and intense. She’s also very pretty…and she knows it. Having been spoilt by her domineering carpenter father, Reginald Matthews, she is deeply insecure and wants only to secure herself a wealthy man so that she can escape Moonlight and live happily ever after.
translation: Maggie Matthews is young, dark and intense. She’s also very pretty…and she knows it. Having been spoilt by her domineering carpenter father, Reginald Matthews, she is deeply insecure and wants only to secure herself a wealthy man so that she can escape Moonlight and live happily ever after.
